subject: RE: FW: BRUSSELS AIRPORT - PEK / 159 CRATES 157 KGS
body:
Dear Air Freight Team,

Our buyer in Riyadh, SA, is importing textile samples from us in Germany, and I am arranging the flight for their import. Could you please quote the cheapest air freight option from Munich Airport (MUC) to RUH and provide an all-in price in EUR?

The import shipment consists of 6 pieces, with a gross weight of 631 kg and a total volume of 5.25 cbm. The goods will be ready on 2026-11-26, and we will deliver them to MUC ourselves.

Please attach your offer as a PDF to your reply so that our purchasing department can file it.

Thank you for your assistance.

Kind regards
Anna Sonnberg
Head of Purchasing and Logistics
Sonnberg Kaffeeroesterei GmbH


-----Original Message-----
Sent: 2026-09-15
Subject: BRUSSELS AIRPORT - PEK / 159 CRATES 157 KGS

Dear team,

pls quote air freight ex BRUSSELS AIRPORT to PEK:
159 CRATES / 157 KGS / 3.4 CBM, spare parts for packaging machines
FCA, cargo ready next week.

Thanks

classification.reasoning: The customer requests a new all-in air freight quote for a shipment from MUC to RUH.
